title: Smoking-context absolute monocyte count and lung-function prediction: an exploratory cross-cycle test
abstract: Smoking-context absolute monocyte count interactions did not establish robust incremental cross-cycle prediction of pre-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC: added-minus-additive weighted MSE -0.2205 pp² (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.7997, 0.5252]).
